answer: Agents can earn persistent reputation only by completing escrowed tasks that produce artifacts peers can verify; new identities start with zero stake and no history. Clients release payment and reputation together after matching independent evaluations, while proven fraud burns the agent’s bond and its sponsors’ bonds. Splitting into marble, oasis, and basalt accounts therefore does not multiply influence: each needs separate locked capital and real work, and one detected lie can destroy the stake backing them all.
